column1: # event-rules.tsv (harbor#1044) — the `harbor event on` rules Harbor ships as presets. NONE is on.
# A line `#stub<TAB>id<TAB>reason` is a preset that is designed and NOT built: `harbor event on --preset <id>`
# refuses it (exit 4) and prints the reason. To every other reader of this file it is a comment.
# A preset is installed only by `harbor event on --preset <id>`, which refuses it unless docs/reference/checks.md has
# its register row naming every kind its pattern names and its disable command. Nothing installs these
# on deploy: the dispatcher ships inert (operator decision 2026-10-07).
# COLUMNS (tab-separated, no header row)
#   id        event.<object>, its docs/reference/checks.md register id
#   pattern   grep -E over the event line, as `harbor event wait` takes it
#   debounce  seconds between two fires on one (rule, subject)
#   rate      fires per rolling hour, 1-60
#   backstop  seconds without a fire after which the dispatcher fires it anyway; 0 = none
#   handler   exactly `sh {cfg}/bin/<script>`; {cfg} is the config dir ($CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, else ~/.claude).
#             These scripts ARE the cmd-handler allowlist: event-dispatch.sh's HANDLERS must name exactly
#             them (registry.test.sh), each runtime-install ships, and a rule runs one only while its bytes
#             are the blob {cfg}/.harbor-manifest records. No free-form command (harbor#1044 review r2 #1).
event.fleet-snapshot
event.pulse
event.session-notify
event.session-save-now
